tool_config.name: add_note
tool_config.description: Append the Foreman's note to one of their own Requests that find_open_requests returned, for example "need an answer today". Never creates a Request and never changes the Request's fields. Returns {"ok": true} when the note is added, or {"error": "..."} if it could not be added.

request_body_schema.description: The Request and the note, after it is clear which Request the note is for.

ref.description: The ref of the Request as find_open_requests returned it, for example R-1042.

text.description: The note in the Foreman's own words, for example "need an answer today".

urgent.description: true when the Foreman says they need it sooner or need an answer today; leave it out otherwise.
